title: The Lancashire Farm Shop Creamery Custard Cannoli 100ml Shortfill
description: The Lancashire Creamery’s Custard Cannoli recreates the essence of the classic Italian pastry, blending rich, buttery notes of a crisp Cannoli shell with a smooth, velvety Custard filling. The pastry-inspired base delivers a delicate sweetness, while the Custard adds a creamy depth with a warm, indulgent finish. This expertly layered flavour captures the comforting taste of a beloved dessert, offering a deeply satisfying vape. With a 70% VG / 30% PG formulation, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, making it ideal for high-powered vape kits, mods, sub-ohm tanks, and low-resistance coils. The thick VG content ensures dense vapour production while delivering consistently rich flavour. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The Lancashire Creamery is a UK-based e-liquid brand known for crafting rich, indulgent dessert flavours. Their shortfill collection blends classic bakery, custard, and milkshake profiles, delivering smooth, full-bodied vapes for those who enjoy creamy, sweet treats.
